# Testing Alignment

- Contract tests: Definition, Artifact Type Request, Artifact Type, and migration schema.
- Inventory tests: total source accounting and exact selected-file digests.
- Mapping tests: one rule and destination per selected file; no traversal or collision.
- Rehearsal tests: deterministic sample copy in an isolated temporary directory.
- Evolution tests: imported bytes cannot shadow active Lab packages.
- Recovery tests: rollback equals the exact create-set and never includes source bytes.
